title: Explain SQL capture: test both Locus branches, add the concurrent IT, and stop unrelated SQL reaching the log appenders

criteria.given: a worker thread logs SQL while a Locus is pushed on it
criteria.then: MondrianStatementScopeTest has a case where the explained statement's Locus is claimed and a separate case where a foreign statement's Locus is rejected

criteria.given: foreign queries log SQL on other threads while a cell explain runs
criteria.then: CellExplainServiceTest has explain_underConcurrentForeignQueries_returnsOnlyCallersSql, which asserts the returned sql is only the caller's

criteria.given: a probe is open and an unrelated execution logs SQL at DEBUG
criteria.then: the appenders already attached to the Mondrian loggers (file/console) do not receive it, and a test asserts that, while records at the configured level still reach them
